description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reno
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Pyramid (0~2), removed after using Apex Pyramid two times

description.name: Apex Pyramid Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Pyramid level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reno]

description.name: Apex Pyramid Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Pyramid level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Reno]
